subject: Problem: vectorize the following in Stan

messages.author: 1c70f0703f55d650
messages.subject: Problem: vectorize the following in Stan
parts:
The problem is the following. You have a matrix V and matrices Q,W. All have dimension nxm. You want to select certain elements from V and use them to increase the log-likelihood. The elements are selected based on the corresponding values from the "condition matrices" Q and W.

The basic (non-vectorized) code looks like this

matrix[n,m] lik_mat;
lik_mat=rep_mat(0,n,m); //collects likelihood values

for (i in 1:n){
     for (j in 1:m){
 
if (Q[i,j]==1){  //condition 1
  
  if (W[i,j]>0) { //condition 2
  lik_mat[i,j]=gumbel_lpdf(log(V[i,j]])|0,sigmaeps);}
   
  if (W[i,j]==0){ 
  lik_mat[i,j]=gumbel_lcdf(log([V[i,j])|0,sigmaeps);}
}
}
}
target+=sum(lik_mat)


The problem is making the selection, taking the log from the selected values and then either applying gumbel_lpdf or gumbel_lcdf. I am not sure how to improve from the basic loop-case.

I would appreciate any ideas or tips you may have in making this faster.

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Problem: vectorize the following in Stan
parts:
Looks like you're doing censoring here and I'm going
to guess that Q and W are integers (in which case they
should be arrays, not matrices).

If you need to compute lik_mat rather than just
summing, you can't really do any better than this.

But if you only need the lik_mat to do that sum, then
it's much more efficient to collect the values together
and vectorize.

Most efficiently, you'd pack declare a new (m * n) variable
v that is V packed into an array (you can use to_array to
define it).

Then in transformed data, collect two integer arrays of idxs1.

idxs1: indexes of v where you want to use lpdf
idxs2: indexes of v where you want to use lcdf

then replace that whole code block with this:

target += gumbel_lpdf(v[idxs1], 0, sigmaeps);
target += gumbel_lcdf(v[idxs2], 0, sigmaeps);

It won't be particularly transparent, but you can probably
do something like rename idxs1 as cases_observed and
idxs2 as cases_censored or something like that if that's
what you're coding.

- Bob
